title: Pipeline Role Pins 2026-06-19
purpose: Harden the wave launcher so a wave can pin implementer, reviewer, and pager route at launch time without dirtying executor_config.json in linked worktrees. The fix should make the launcher carry role and pager intent through the dispatcher environment, while keeping existing defaults unchanged.
evidence_delta: (1) Waves can declare launch-time implementer and reviewer role pins that are passed to the dispatcher as environment overrides instead of requiring linked-worktree executor_config.json edits. (2) Waves can declare a launch-time pager route pin so operator-visible pager targets do not drift from the intended agent route. (3) Existing launcher configs and pager defaults remain backward-compatible.
progress_proof_before: A linked-worktree wave can inherit stale executor_config.json role settings, and an already-running Phase B captures that backend for re-entry. Operators then see Claude pager or implementer signals even after the intended role switch is Codex.
progress_proof_after: The launcher owns per-wave role and pager route intent, passes that intent to the dispatcher child deterministically, and leaves committed executor_config.json clean unless the user intentionally changes the global default.
scope_summary: Add launch-time role and pager route pins to the launcher and pager route resolver. This is pipeline tooling only and must not touch runtime, substrate, seed, or StructuralNumbers engine files.
scope_items: mu/tools/executors/launch_wave.py (MODIFY) -- add optional implementer, reviewer, and pager route config fields and thread them to dispatcher launch environment.
mu/tools/observability/pipeline_agent_pager.py (MODIFY) -- honor a pipeline-owned pager route override environment variable before executor_config.json route.
mu/tests/tools/test_launch_wave.py (MODIFY) -- cover role and pager pin validation plus dispatcher runner environment.
mu/tests/tools/test_pipeline_agent_pager.py (MODIFY) -- cover pager route env override precedence and validation.
reports/l4_wave_indicators/pipeline-role-pins-2026-06-19.json (GENERATED) -- indicator artifact from the configured collection command.
work_items: Extend WaveConfig with optional implementer_agent, reviewer_agent, and pager_route fields that default to empty strings and preserve current behavior when omitted.

Validate non-empty agent pins against the configured bridge agent defaults and known display-name set, and validate pager_route against the pager route set without importing observability code into launch_wave.
When --launch is enabled, pass RCX_IMPLEMENTER_AGENT_OVERRIDE and RCX_REVIEWER_AGENT_OVERRIDE for non-empty role pins through the dispatcher child environment.

When pager_route is non-empty, pass RCX_PIPELINE_AGENT_PAGER_ROUTE_OVERRIDE through the dispatcher child environment and make pipeline_agent_pager route resolution honor it before executor_config.json.
Make launch result metadata expose only non-secret override keys and values needed for auditability.
Add focused tests for omitted pins, valid pins, invalid pins, dispatcher env threading, and pager route env precedence.
Run the evidence command and collect the indicator artifact.
constraints: Use the pipeline launcher and dispatcher path for this wave.
Do not modify executor_config.json as the fix; the point is per-wave launch intent without linked-worktree config dirtiness.
Do not touch runtime, substrate, seed, registry, projection seed, JS parity, or StructuralNumbers engine files.
Do not change the global default implementer or pager route in this wave.
stop_conditions: Stop done when role pins and pager route pins are test-covered, the evidence command passes, and the indicator artifact is collected.
Halt as POLICY_BOUND if dispatcher subprocess environment cannot be controlled by launch_wave.
If the fix requires changing global executor_config defaults, re-scope rather than weakening the per-wave pin contract.
Do not commit without a real handoff artifact and gate-green evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A launcher config that omits role and pager pins behaves exactly as before.
A launcher config with implementer_agent codex and reviewer_agent codex launches the dispatcher with RCX_IMPLEMENTER_AGENT_OVERRIDE=codex and RCX_REVIEWER_AGENT_OVERRIDE=codex.
A launcher config with pager_route codex launches the dispatcher with RCX_PIPELINE_AGENT_PAGER_ROUTE_OVERRIDE=codex.
pipeline_agent_pager resolves RCX_PIPELINE_AGENT_PAGER_ROUTE_OVERRIDE before executor_config.json route and rejects invalid override values.
Launcher result metadata records the applied role and pager override values without dumping unrelated environment.
The configured pytest files pass and host semantics ratchet reports no increase.
request_for_claude: Implement per-wave role and pager route pins through the pipeline-owned Phase A and Phase B path only. Keep defaults backward-compatible, do not dirty executor_config.json as the fix, add focused launcher and pager tests, run the configured evidence command, collect the indicator artifact, and keep runtime/substrate/seed files out of scope.
authorization_note: Standing pipeline hardening authorization: manual role env override was required to unblock a linked-worktree wave after stale config capture; this wave turns that workaround into deterministic launcher behavior.
routing_summary: Pipeline launcher hardening for per-wave implementer, reviewer, and pager route pins.
